name: io.github.RamaAditya49/titen-memory
title: Titen Memory
description: Evidence-grounded agent memory with mandatory provenance, on local SQLite or Cloudflare D1

environmentVariables.name: TITEN_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Streamable HTTP /mcp endpoint of a running Titen service. Set together with TITEN_API_KEY to use a shared store instead of the local one.

environmentVariables.name: TITEN_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. API key for the Titen service named by TITEN_MCP_URL. Required only when TITEN_MCP_URL is set.
